concept: Coding and Decoding in Fictitious Language
question: In a certain code language, 'he came back' is written as 'ni ji pa', 'go back now' is written as 'pa ja ka' and 'stop it now' is written as 'ka my uk' . How will 'go' be written in the same code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'he came back' means 'ni ji pa', 'go back now' means 'pa ja ka' and 'stop it now' means 'ka my uk'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b45ae7e3305841f52af9614806a43d8dc18fed37884fa69c99b584c1cf71c47.png] 

∴ Here, 'go' is coded as 'ja'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"ja".**
